extracted.name: Frozen Margaritas
extracted.description: This frozen margarita recipe uses frozen limeade concentrate for an easy twist on the classic recipe. Making a margarita has never been easier!
ingredient_lines: 4 cups crushed ice, or as needed
instruction_lines: Fill a blender with crushed ice. Pour in limeade concentrate, tequila, and triple sec; blend until smooth. Pour into margarita glasses and serve with lime wedges if desired.
